authority: the competent authority of your state of registration
summary: No member state is selected for this organisation, so only the EU-level frame applies: the operational authorisation is granted by the competent authority of the state where the operator is registered, on the strength of a risk assessment the operator supplies. Choose a country in Settings to get that authority's process checklist.

items.title: Choose the state of registration
items.detail: Set the country in Settings. The determination itself does not change — the national overrides are empty until an annex is transcribed — but the submission checklist does.
items.source: Verify which authority is competent for your operation against EU 2019/947.
